entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: Please I need confirmation she is still on bail. The Brighton Fringe are treating us as separate partners; she is my abuser not my partner. My acts are being told there is a dispute between us, as she's photoshopped herself off bail.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: Good morning Ben, I hope you are well. I'm sorry to hear about the difficulties you have had with Alana. I have now written to one of the police supervisors to confirm the status of the bail conditions and the investigation and I will get back to you as soon as I hear back from them. In the meantime could you please provide access to your Google Drive by replying to an email from admin@veritas-justice.co.uk so that our technical support person can scan and download the material, many thanks, and I will be in touch soon.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: No way, PC Dixon is still my officer.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: What's going on?

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: As I've had no update I'll assume Alanna isn't off bail?

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: Or she is and I haven't been told?

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: Hi Ben, I hope you are ok, unfortunately I haven't got an update for you, I have been told that a supervisor has been tasked with reviewing the case and appoint a new officer. Once that has been completed someone should be making contact with you. In terms of bail I don't have any further information either. I will be chasing up again soon and will let you know as soon as I have any news. Can I double‑check that you haven't had any new incidents or further contact from Alana? Please let me know if you would like to have a chat. Kind regards, Emma.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: I have not had any confirmation about the status of bail, unfortunately.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: Yeah but if you haven't been told and I haven't, that means she must be on bail, Victims' Code.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: Changes of investigating officers often leads to additional delays, I am chasing them, so I totally share your frustration.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: What officers were at the MARAC meeting? You told me PC Dixon told you he wasn't going to be my officer; what other officers were there? I find this very strange given the meeting was about safeguarding me.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: This is not true under UK law, I have a right to be safeguarded; no one has contacted me since my suicide — this is not a procedural change, this is human rights.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: As mentioned on our previous phone call, PC Dixon did not attend the meeting given your request that the OIC should be changed. I agree delays are not enshrined in law; however, passing over files causes delays. I am advocating for you to get answers. In terms of safety please let me know if there have been any further incidents or support required; I can consider additional referrals.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: A police representative, not the OIC.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: Sergeant from police stalking unit — DS Burtup.

entries.speaker: Emma (Veritas)
entries.quote: Email: CDAU@sussex.police.uk

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: They almost got me again.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: Yeah could you tell Sussex Police for me; they should know by law. Maybe they weren't told.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: Shared: Google Drive link — 'Alanna 22-05-25 00-35 accuses me of raping her – VEED (1).mp4'

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: The police hang up when I ring.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: This isn’t sustainable, I can't live; it's one year since I said 'police please'.

entries.speaker: Ben
entries.quote: I haven't left the flat since May 8th; they've completely dismantled my life.
